previous_catalog_record.summary: 2-4 isolated components sorted by (hole_count desc, area desc, color asc) and packed left-to-right, top-aligned, 1 blank column between crops. tie_holes boards share a hole count so AREA decides; tie_area boards share holes AND area so COLOR decides. (Was: always exactly 3 components with distinct hole counts 0/1/2 — the sort's tie-break keys were never exercised.)

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-derived packed grid: its output dimensions, component geometry, and left-to-right component order are determined by Stage A rather than by the source positions.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Crop every nonzero 4-connected component, sort the crops by enclosed-hole count descending, foreground area descending, then color ascending, and pack them top-aligned from left to right with one blank column between crops.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Recompute the components on that packed intermediate from left to right and recolor their occupied cells with rank colors 1, 2, 3, and 4.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Stage B assigns colors by positions in the packed intermediate. Skipping Stage A instead ranks the original source positions, preserving the source canvas and assigning ranks to different component roles, so the final geometry and cell colors change.

parametric_work.summary: Exact-canonical original and sequential rank-color settings with matched inputs, 2–6 distinguishing demonstrations, four sequential private queries, substantive 30x30 stress, reusable adversarial tools, native inventory, authoring preflight, and protected skip-A causal witness.

target_report.summary: Repaired the base generator contract and built a source-bound native family with the byte-exact canonical default plus a causal pack-then-rank setting. Three concrete minimum-lesson shortcuts were reproduced, repaired, and retained as regressions; final protected-Racket, qualification, witness, and export checks passed.
